description: Hand-written responses for case concurrency-race, used to test the evaluation harness offline (pnpm eval --provider fake --recorded). They were not produced by a model and say nothing about any model's review quality; record real ones with pnpm eval --record.

findings.title: Concurrent reservations can oversell: get-then-set is not atomic
findings.description: Two requests can read the same `available` value and both pass the check and write, losing one decrement (a race the atomic decrementIfAvailable prevented).
findings.impact: Stock goes negative and orders are accepted for items that are not there.

evidence.why: The level is read and written in separate calls.

findings.suggestedFix: Keep the atomic conditional UPDATE (decrementIfAvailable) or wrap the read and write in a transaction with SELECT … FOR UPDATE.

reasons: Scripted verdict: the cited code shows the problem.
